name: Name
empty-description: Upload files or drop them here. Large files keep uploading if your connection drops.
empty-picker-description: Upload a file to use it here.
invalid-name: Enter a name under 255 characters, without slashes.
trash-folder-confirm: Move "{{name}}" and everything in it to trash?
delete-forever-confirm: Delete permanently? This can't be undone.
move-description: Open the folder to move it into, then choose Move here.
trash-retention: Items are deleted forever after 30 days
trash-empty-description: Deleted files stay here for 30 days before they're removed for good.
no-preview: Preview isn't available for this type
appearance-description: Pick a color, an icon, or a cover image for this folder's card.
sheet-first-only: Only "{{name}}" is shown; the file has {{count}} more sheets.
shared-empty-description: Folders others share with you appear here.
access-description: Choose who can open this folder and what they can do. Everything inside follows the folder.
access-forbidden: Only the folder's managers can see and change who has access.
restricted-description: Only the people listed below get in; access from the parent folder stops here.
no-grants: No one is added to this folder itself.
roles-hint: Viewers open and download. Contributors also upload and create folders. Managers also rename, move, delete, share and change access. The highest role someone has wins.
tier-inherit-description: Everyone who can open this folder can open the new one.
tier-private-description: Hidden from everyone else until you share it.
tier-organization-description: All team members can view and download.
tier-selected-description: Starts private; pick people or structure nodes next.
file-access-description: Choose who else can open this file. People with access to its folder keep it.
public-link-hint: Anyone with the link can open this file
pin-limit: You can pin up to 10 items
bulk-share-description: Add people to every selected item. Access they already have stays as it is.
bulk-share-files-hint: Files can only be viewed or managed, so contributor access on a file lets people view it.
